items.question: Which UAE government entity launched the Diwan eBook Reader app?
items.gold: The Ministry of Education launched the Diwan eBook Reader.
items.fact: Ministry of Education launched the Diwan eBook Reader app

items.question: Who can use the Diwan eBook Reader to view and interact with the learning curriculum electronically?
items.gold: Teachers and students from government schools.
items.fact: Diwan eBook Reader users are teachers and government school students
